name: Hermiq
summary: Schedule autonomous AI agents in Nextcloud
goal: Hermiq brings autonomous AI agents to Nextcloud. Define an agent, give it tools, and run it on a schedule — daily reports, inbox triage, monitoring, morning briefings — all inside your own Nextcloud, delivered to Nextcloud Talk. Agents, their memory and their self-improving skills are stored as OpenRegister objects, so every run is governed, auditable and multi-tenant. Hermiq is the Nextcloud-native, self-hostable, sovereign take on the autonomous-agent platform, inspired by NousResearch Hermes. Architecturally (ADR-001, Option C+) Hermiq is a thin app: it owns scheduling/triggers and the agent-management UX (agent catalog, skills marketplace, run analytics) and delegates the agent core, tools and governance to OpenRegister, connectors to OpenConnector, and heavy visual workflows to n8n.
author: Conduction B.V.
